defect: The first live recording and visual proof were not bound to one exact package tarball.
failureScenario: A polished GIF can depict different executable bytes from the package proof and make a broken candidate look releasable.
evidence: The final demo manifest and W6 package proof both contain tarball SHA-256 32dda757d252bff4e120a8c69d776cb76b3ee971e3f2649d661875e77a20f7b8.
fix: Reject any demo whose commit, version, tarball name, or tarball hash differs from the exact package proof.
verification: Luna Max APPROVE; four public demo hashes and 69 W6 manifest hashes pass sha256sum --check.
costIfShipped: One public proof could describe bytes other than the reviewed package.
savedIfFixed: Every published frame now binds to one reviewed tarball.

defect: Estimated aggregate analysis cost could be stored as observed cost or discarded while model-call estimates remained.
failureScenario: A user reads the session total and treats an estimated Router price as reported spend, or sees no likely total.
evidence: The real analysis records costUsd null, estimatedCostUsd 0.075986, and costStatus estimated for six calls.
fix: Keep reported, estimated, observed-floor, and unknown cost states separate through mapping, storage, projection, and rendering.
verification: Usage tests cover partial, complete, estimate-only, cancelled, and unknown cases; Luna Max confirmed no observed claim.
costIfShipped: One misleading aggregate per estimated analysis session.
savedIfFixed: Observed and estimated amounts remain independently inspectable.

defect: The activity view did not expose each trace-analysis model call and its accounting evidence.
failureScenario: A six-call analysis appears as one opaque result, so a user cannot identify the slow or expensive call.
evidence: The real demo retains calls 1 through 6 with provider, model, tokens, cost state, latency, and outcome.
fix: Project typed execution evidence into one analysis document and render every retained call.
verification: Analysis round-trip and presentation tests pass; the GIF displays all six calls across two pages.
costIfShipped: Six hidden call records per one measured demo analysis.
savedIfFixed: Six of six call records remain visible and auditable.

defect: Plain package proof retried after run.finished but before the completed execution effect settled.
failureScenario: A valid package emits an invalid operation identifier or hangs during cancellation under one observed event ordering.
evidence: The pre-fix exact package proof failed once; the focused four-run reproduction and final exact package proof pass.
fix: Count a completion only after both the terminal run event and completed effect are visible.
verification: Focused plain proof passes 4 of 4 and verify-package passes for commit bd8f607.
costIfShipped: One false release failure per observed race ordering.
savedIfFixed: The proof waits for the durable user-visible consequence.

defect: Separate stacked workflow overlays made analysis, worker, and event navigation inconsistent and visually crowded.
failureScenario: A user opens /ask detail, loses context, and cannot predict whether Escape or left arrow returns to the list.
evidence: One ActivityDocument now drives the shared browser, and keyboard tests preserve selection across list and detail.
fix: Use one divided entity browser for activity scopes and make left arrow and Escape equivalent return actions.
verification: The 40x12 workflow test and all 11 visual state captures pass.
costIfShipped: Two competing navigation models in one terminal.
savedIfFixed: One browser and one back behavior cover analyses, workers, runs, and events.

defect: Terminal surfaces could combine the selected future profile with identity fields from the admitted active run.
failureScenario: A user changes the selected profile while a run remains visible and reads the wrong runner, model, or connection.
evidence: The execution target selects either one immutable run receipt or the current future profile.
fix: Project one coherent execution target and reuse it in chrome and activity context.
verification: Terminal usage and responsive identity tests pass across all four reference sizes.
costIfShipped: One mixed identity whenever a future selection differs from the active run.
savedIfFixed: Each visible run names one profile, runner, model, connection, and environment.

defect: The public recorder stopped on the first analysis page and omitted later evidence.
failureScenario: A viewer sees only four of six calls and cannot tell whether the remaining accounting evidence exists.
evidence: The final GIF reaches page 2 of 2 and validates visible call numbers 1 through 6.
fix: Traverse every reported page, assert every expected call, and retain page one as the static hero.
verification: All 18 live-demo tests pass; Luna Max confirmed both pages and all six calls.
costIfShipped: Two hidden calls per one six-call demo analysis.
savedIfFixed: Six of six calls appear while the README image remains information-dense.

defect: The previous public image looked like a fixture and omitted Braid's runner-neutral product identity.
failureScenario: A developer cannot tell whether Braid controls a real runner, which AgentProfile ran, or what the analysis adds.
evidence: The new hero shows Product engineer, Pi 0.84.1, GLM-5.2, Local CLI Bridge, tokens, latency, citations, and six calls.
fix: Record a real packaged Pi coding task, verify its external workspace, run /ask, and publish the GIF plus manifest.
verification: Pi passes 17 of 17 workspace tests; the analysis completes three cited findings; gitleaks finds no artifact secrets.
costIfShipped: The main product surface presents Braid as an unproven toy.
savedIfFixed: The README demonstrates the complete portable profile, execution, and analysis path.
